newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 12 die in India bus collision - agency.
newsitem.headline: At least 12 die in India bus collision - agency.

text.p: At least twelve people were killed and 65 injured when two buses rammed into each other on Wednesday in the eastern Indian state of West Bengal, the Press Trust of India said.
It said the accident occured on the Grand Trunk Road, which crosses India, in Bardhman district some 200 km (125 miles) northwest of the state capital, Calcutta.
Three women and one child were among the dead, the news agency said.
